title_en: Notice of Column Adjustment of the Gazette of the Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China
full_text_en:
Notice on Column Adjustment of the Gazette of the Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China

Starting from 2024, the "Cases" column of the Gazette of the Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China will be adjusted to the "Guiding Cases" column. Guiding cases are cases determined and uniformly published by the Supreme People's Court that have a guiding role in the trial and enforcement work of courts nationwide. The content of the original "Cases" column will continue to be retained on this website.

We thank our readers for their attention and support!
